evidence_sources.citation: Willcockson, Bill. Genesis Sample Return Capsule Overview. Lockheed Martin / JPL overview, August 25, 2004.
evidence_sources.claim_scope: Genesis-class capsule heritage mass and diameter used as the v1 geometry/mass proxy.
evidence_sources.notes: Provides Entry Mass = 206 kg and Diameter = 1.52 m for the Genesis SRC.

evidence_sources.citation: Finckenor, Miria. Optical Property Measurements on the Stardust Sample Return Capsule. June 25, 2007.
evidence_sources.claim_scope: Qualitative post-flight durability precedent for sample-return capsule materials after a multi-year mission.
evidence_sources.notes: Useful as qualitative survivability precedent only; it does not provide a direct deep-time degradation rate.
